summary: iter250 — End-to-end Playwright verification of the new MakerPayoutsPrompt inside /welcome Step 4. All 6 tests PASSED on desktop (1920x1080): (1) anon state renders as <A href='/maker/login'> with required copy and is positioned before the action <ol>; (2) buyer path does NOT render the prompt; (3) supporter path does NOT render the prompt; (4) with a valid maker JWT minted via issue_session_jwt('williams-cnc',...) the prompt renders as <BUTTON> with 'Connect Stripe — get paid in 2 min' copy (needs-connect state, as expected since the maker has no Stripe account); (5) full /welcome flow regression — Step 1 → Step 4 walk, back buttons (step 4→3→2), refresh-resume (after picking maker, reload lands on Step 3 correctly), all unchanged from iter249; (6) skip button still works (POSTs /api/onboarding/skip, sets cm_onboarding_skipped, navigates to /). Position assertion confirmed: prompt y=318, ol y=426 (prompt is visually first). Cyan-orange call-out border styling present (border-[#ff4500]/60 bg-[#ff4500]/5). No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: MakerPayoutsPrompt unused import 'ExternalLink' is actually used in the Connect/Resume badge — no issue. Unused 'Loader2' import in Welcome.jsx top-level if not used elsewhere — verify (it IS used inside MakerPayoutsPrompt for busy state, so OK).

Minor UX: on /maker/stripe/connect/status failure, prompt falls through to 'needs-connect' state which will then trigger /maker/stripe/connect/onboard on click — this could mask underlying auth/network errors. Consider showing a soft error state instead of optimistically routing to onboard.
Observation: WebSocket /api/ws/chat/help 404s appear in console for makers — pre-existing, unrelated to iter250.
test_credentials: Maker JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('williams-cnc','williams342@gmail.com','maker'). Worked; status endpoint returned non-connected state as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MakerPayoutsPrompt (Welcome.jsx L484) verified in all 3 conditional branches (anon link, needs-connect button, render-suppression for non-maker paths). The 'ready' (payouts_enabled) state was NOT exercised because the test maker has no Stripe account — main agent should retest after a successful Stripe Express onboarding completes if regression coverage on the ready state is needed. /welcome regression flow remains green: Step 1→2→3→4 navigation, back buttons across all steps, refresh-resume (on user_type set, resumes at Step 3), skip button.
